tool.name: Test Tool
tool.description: Execute another tool by slug with optional arguments and report ok/fail plus duration. Fetches the tool definition first, then runs its blueprint (may have side effects).

arguments.description: Arguments object to pass to the target tool blueprint

timeoutMs.description: Optional timeout for the nested run (ms)

targetSlug.description: Slug of the tool to execute

nodes.name: Validate Input
nodes.description: Validate targetSlug, normalize test arguments, and document HTTP usage

nodes.name: Get Tool (Starships)
nodes.description: Fetch tool definition via Starships connector action

nodes.name: Prepare Test Execution
nodes.description: Extract tool definition and prepare arguments

nodes.name: Emit Test Arguments
nodes.description: Extract only the test arguments to pass into the Tool node

nodes.name: Execute Tool
nodes.description: Run the tool blueprint with test arguments
